summary.text: Clint Moses is a Republican member of the Wisconsin State Assembly who has represented District 92 since 2021 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026, general election.
A chiropractor, he chairs the Assembly Health Committee.

paragraphs.text: Clint Moses was born in Menomonie, Wisconsin, and graduated from Menomonie High School in 1995.
He earned a degree from the University of Wisconsin at Stout and a doctorate in chiropractic from Northwestern College of Chiropractic.
Moses' career experience includes working as the CEO and a chiropractor with Red Cedar Chiropractic.
Moses has served in the Assembly since 2021.

In the 2025-2026 session he chairs the Health Committee, is vice-chair of the Agriculture Committee, and sits on the Colleges and Universities, Forestry, Parks, and Outdoor Recreation, and State Affairs committees.
Ballotpedia lists him as chairman of the Aging and Long-Term Care and Health committees in the 2023-2024 session.
